title: Use of object-oriented programming in enterprise projects
answer: In enterprise projects, OOP helps organize a large codebase into cohesive components with clear responsibilities, stable contracts, protected state, reusable behavior, and substitutable implementations. This supports maintainability, testing, team ownership, and controlled evolution. AeroTopo's Product abstraction centralizes common product rules, interfaces define contracts, subclasses isolate product-specific logic, and composition is used for owned data. OOP is useful when it models real domain responsibilities; it should not be used to create deep hierarchies without a clear design benefit.
